title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: The decomposition 'centre = centre(SG) × (kernel of the T°-action on SG)' is incorrect when T° acts on SG through inner automorphisms. Any t ∈ T° acting as Ad(s) for some s in SG gives a central element (s^{-1}, t). The centre is then larger than μ2 × ker(action), which is consistent with Grothendieck's marginal 'faux! centre de dim 3' and the striking out of (13).
Consequently the identification of the neutral component of the centre as ST_ρ × ST_σ (dimension 2) in the closing remark is also wrong, by his own later marginal verdict.
The integral-point count in (14), Z/6 × Z/4 × Z/2, is correct for ST_ρ(Z) = μ6(Z[ζ6]), ST_σ(Z) = μ4(Z[i]) and μ2(Z). However, it computes the points of the wrong group scheme, given the error above.

ideas.what: Algebraic group schemes over Z attached to the modular-group data (a form of GL2 with an order-6 element ρ, an order-4 element σ and a unipotent ε0 = -σ^{-1}ρ), and the computation of their centres via centralizer tori
ideas.modern_name: Integral models / algebraic envelopes of SL2(Z) presentations; norm-one tori of the centralizers Res_{Z[ζ6]/Z}G_m and Res_{Z[i]/Z}G_m
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard torus/centralizer theory (SGA3); the specific M_{ρ,σ} construction appears only in these notes
ideas.where_published: Possibly related themes in Esquisse d'un programme / Longue Marche (modular group, Teichmüller tower); the M_{ρ,σ} groups themselves appear unpublished

ideas.what: Integral points of norm-one tori: ST_ρ(Z) ≅ Z/6 and ST_σ(Z) ≅ Z/4 (unit groups of Z[ζ6] and Z[i])
ideas.modern_name: Norm-one torus R^1_{O_K/Z}G_m, roots of unity in imaginary quadratic orders

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine but erroneous centre computation for auxiliary group schemes in the 'équation des lacets' notes. Grothendieck himself marks it 'faux' and restarts on the next page. It contains no new result or connection beyond what the broader manuscript already contains.
transcription_corrections: Last factor in (14) is most likely ℤ/2ℤ (= Γμ2 ⊂ Γ(SG)), not ℤ/12ℤ; the '/2' is written so as to resemble '.12'.
'qui n'est pas deux fois plus gros que' should likely read 'qui n'est que deux fois plus gros que' (48 = 2 × 24, comparing with (52) of the previous page).
In the set description, read {(1,a,b) | det b = 1, det a = 1}, i.e. ≅ ST_ρ × ST_σ (the second factor is ST_σ, not ST).
Marginal notes: 'faux!' beside the T° ∩ (1×T_ρ×T_σ) computation, and 'faux! centre de dim 3' beside (13)/(14).
'comme le suggérait la décision des th. p. 501'' probably reads 'comme le suggérait la discussion [?] des th. p. 501''.
